nodes.label: app_number Migration-Never-Ran Production Bug
nodes.rationale: sql/05_neon_fixes.sql (now 001_app_number_and_timestamps.sql) was written but never actually run against Neon; code depending on its applications.app_number column shipped and broke production before anyone noticed — the fix existed, it just never executed. This directory exists so every .sql file here is auto-run by deploy.yml on every deploy, in filename order.

nodes.label: Additive-Only Idempotency Rules for neon_fixes
nodes.rationale: Every statement must be safe to run unlimited times against a database already in any state (CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, guarded DO $$ blocks); no DROP TABLE or data-deleting statements, since CI runs this unattended on every push with no review gate before it executes against production.
